hermes.rule.rankingEnabled.name: Ranking enabled
hermes.rule.rankingEnabled.desc: Master switch for all Hermes Lib data collection. When disabled no metric is collected at all.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackPlayTime.name: Track play time
hermes.rule.rankingTrackPlayTime.desc: Collect how long each player (or fake player) has been online.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackBlocksMined.name: Track blocks mined
hermes.rule.rankingTrackBlocksMined.desc: Collect how many blocks each player has broken.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackBlocksPlaced.des: Collect how many blocks each player has placed.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackMobKills.name: Track mob kills
hermes.rule.rankingTrackMobKills.desc: Collect how many mobs each player has killed.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackPlayerKills.name: Track player kills
hermes.rule.rankingTrackPlayerKills.desc: Collect how many players each player has killed.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackDeaths.name: Track deaths
hermes.rule.rankingTrackDeaths.desc: Collect how many times each player has died.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackVillagerTrades.d: Collect how many villager trades each player has made.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackFishCaught.name: Track fish caught
hermes.rule.rankingTrackFishCaught.desc: Collect how many times each player has reeled in a fishing hook.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackElytraDistance.d: Collect the distance flown with an elytra, in centi-blocks.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackDamageDealt.name: Track damage dealt
hermes.rule.rankingTrackDamageDealt.desc: Collect the amount of damage each player has dealt.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackDamageTaken.name: Track damage taken
hermes.rule.rankingTrackDamageTaken.desc: Collect the amount of damage each player has taken.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackMovement.name: Track movement
hermes.rule.rankingTrackMovement.desc: Collect walking, sprinting, swimming, riding and elytra distance, in centi-blocks.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackItemsCrafted.des: Collect the number of items produced by crafting.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackItemsPickedUp.de: Collect the number of items picked up from the ground.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackItemsDropped.des: Collect the number of items dropped on the ground.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackItemsUsed.name: Track items used
hermes.rule.rankingTrackItemsUsed.desc: Collect how many times each player has used an item.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackItemsBroken.name: Track items damaged and broken
hermes.rule.rankingTrackItemsBroken.desc: Collect durability damage events and tools or armour that broke completely.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackAnimalsBred.name: Track animals bred
hermes.rule.rankingTrackAnimalsBred.desc: Collect how many times each player has bred animals.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackAnimalsTamed.des: Collect how many animals each player has tamed.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackEnchantments.des: Collect how many enchantments each player has applied.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackJumps.name: Track jumps
hermes.rule.rankingTrackJumps.desc: Collect how many times each player has jumped.
hermes.rule.rankingMinedNaturalOnly.name: Only count natural blocks as mined
hermes.rule.rankingMinedNaturalOnly.desc: Only count blocks that were not placed by a player. Prevents place-then-mine farming.
hermes.rule.rankingSeparateFakePlayers.d: Store fake player data in the FAKE domain instead of REAL. When disabled fake data still keeps its own UUID, so real player data is never overwritten.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackSurvival.name: Track survival mode players
hermes.rule.rankingTrackSurvival.desc: Whether to track players in survival mode (real players and fake players alike). When disabled, players in this mode produce no stats at all.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackAdventure.name: Track adventure mode players
hermes.rule.rankingTrackAdventure.desc: Whether to track players in adventure mode (real players and fake players alike). When disabled, players in this mode produce no stats at all.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackSpectator.name: Track spectator mode players
hermes.rule.rankingTrackSpectator.desc: Whether to track players in spectator mode (real players and fake players alike). When disabled, players in this mode produce no stats at all.
hermes.rule.rankingTrackCreative.name: Track creative mode players
hermes.rule.rankingTrackCreative.desc: Whether to track players in creative mode (real players and fake players alike). When disabled, players in this mode produce no stats at all.
